description: The Department of the Interior (DOI), Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) for Enhancing Spill Risk Analysis for Proposed Outer Continental Shelf (OCS) Oil and Gas Activities. Responses due by Friday, June 5, 2026 at 5:00PM EST to Stephanie Brock at stephanie_brock@ios.doi.gov.
